newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 18.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

ANI posted a sharp rise in net profit to A$16.33 million for the six months to December 31 early on Tuesday, but its net pre-abnormals was A$8 million, down on expectations of a net of about A$18 million. ANI also said it expected further improvements in the results of its continuing businesses in the second half of the financial year ending June 30.

Seven Network Ltd chairman Kerry Stokes said in a substantial shareholding notice to the Australian Stock Exchange that he had increased his stake in Seven Network to 24.085 percent from 21.98 percent.

Grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Monday it was confident the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) would clear the planned expansion of its Australian Independent Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) unit, seen as a move into Davids' business area.
Normandy and Capral are expected to post their first half profit results later on Tuesday. Normandy expected to post A$50 million profit while Capral is expected to post a net of about A$35 million.
CRA Ltd managing director Leigh Clifford addresses Securities Institute of Australia luncheon in Melbourne.

Canada's small Bre-X Minerals Ltd mining company said on Monday it had teamed up with U.S. giant Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc to develop one of the world's richest gold finds on Indonesia's Borneo island. The Australian Financial Review said Golden Valley, which had claims on the deposit, appeared to have missed out in the deal.
